title: AI for Your Emails, Leads, Customer Support and Daily Reporting

how_it_works: Every email that lands in your inbox is read by Claude and sorted: new lead, customer support or other.
New leads get a follow-up right away and are logged in one Google Sheet.
Support questions get a drafted answer in Gmail that your team checks and sends.
Every morning you get one report of yesterday's leads and support questions.
Next from your list: content generation, your CRM, and what we find in your processes.

2 - Claude Sorts It: New Lead, Customer Support or Other
nodes.notes: Claude reads each email and writes the reply, so nothing sits unanswered.

params.system_message: You read the inbox of a small business and sort every incoming email. Categories: lead (someone asking about buying, pricing, a quote, availability or a booking), support (an existing customer with a question, a problem, a change or a complaint), other (newsletters, suppliers, invoices, spam, auto-replies). If an email asks about pricing and also mentions an existing order, it is support. Write reply in the language the sender used, in a warm, short, plain tone, signed with the business name. For a lead: thank them, answer only what the business description supports, never invent prices, dates or policies, and offer the booking link for a quick call. For support: answer from the email and the business description only; if you are not sure, say the team will confirm and ask for the one detail you need. For other: reply is empty. If the email is empty or unreadable, return other and say why in summary.
